rv.q: Now for the bad news about Thea Sharrock’s production.

Rachel John gives a phenomenal performance the entire evening as the overshadowed sister Nicki and holds her own alongside the powerful vocals of Ms Knight. She also delivers a beautiful rendition of "Saving All My Love" and proves her acting chops, especially during her final scene.

Having loved the original production back in 2013, I jumped at the chance to see The Bodyguard as it returned to London’s glittering West End. Even if you have seen the film, this is one story that never fails to tug at your heart-strings.
